name: Craftsman's Writ: Azure Silk Hood
summary: A faded Craftsman’s Writ requests an Azure Silk Hood and gives terms for its delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Written Terms
sections.body: The note is penned in faded ink and names one item: an Azure Silk Hood. It also gives the place for delivery and the payment. The writ can pass from one bearer to another, but you need it with you to complete the transaction.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Azure Silk Hood.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the hood?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: What do I need for the transaction?
faq.answer: You need the requested item and the writ in your possession.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The note includes information about payment, but the text here does not specify the amount.

faq.q: Can someone else carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. The writ is marked as transferable.
